name: decision-day-runner
description: Runs the sprint's decision mechanics from art museum through heat map, speed critique, straw poll and the Decider's supervote, including what to do when the Decider votes against the room, part of the Design Sprint Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run decision-day-runner", "run the heat map", "how does the supervote work", "we need to pick a sketch", "run the straw poll", or when the sketches are on the wall and the room has to choose. Use it even for a vague ask like "how do we decide between these without a fight".
